control_objective: Ensure privileged access is approved reviewed and limited to business need
evidence_required: Access review export approval record and removed access evidence

control_objective: Ensure critical cloud activities are logged monitored and retained for investigation and audit
evidence_required: Logging configuration screenshot monitoring rule evidence and retention setting

control_objective: Classify sensitive data assets and apply handling requirements based on sensitivity
evidence_required: Data classification register owner approval and handling procedure

control_objective: Assess vendor security posture before approval and maintain evidence for assurance
evidence_required: Vendor questionnaire security evidence risk rating and approval decision

control_objective: Track high severity vulnerabilities through ownership due date remediation and closure validation
evidence_required: Vulnerability scan remediation ticket and closure validation evidence

control_objective: Maintain clear traceability from control requirement to evidence owner status and review date
evidence_required: Evidence register control owner status and quality review notes

control_objective: Ensure security-relevant changes are reviewed approved tested and traceable
evidence_required: Change ticket approval testing evidence and rollback plan

control_objective: Prevent public or overly broad access to sensitive cloud storage
evidence_required: Storage policy screenshot access review and public access block confirmation

control_objective: Ensure incident response procedures are current tested and evidenced
evidence_required: Playbook review record tabletop exercise notes and action tracker

control_objective: Assess privacy risk for new data processing activities and document treatment decisions
evidence_required: DPIA checklist data flow review risk decision and approval record
